=== jl-maj-1
jlFlat = \markup { \raise #0.6 \small \flat }
jlEx = {
  <c e g b>1-\markup { "maj7" }  <c e g a>1-\markup { "6" }  <c ees g bes>1-\markup { "m7" }  <c e g bes>1-\markup { "7" }
  <c e gis bes dis'>1-\markup { "7alt" }  <c e g bes des'>1-\markup { "7" \jlFlat "9" }  <c ees ges bes>1-\markup { "m7" \jlFlat "5" }
  <c ees ges beses>1-\markup { "°7" }  <c ees g a>1-\markup { "m6" }  <c ees g b>1-\markup { "m(maj7)" }
}
\layout { \context { \ChordNames chordNameExceptions = #(append (sequential-music-to-chord-exceptions jlEx #t) ignatzekExceptions) } }
\score { <<
  \new ChordNames \chordmode { c1:maj7 }
  \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \time 4/4 \override Score.NonMusicalPaperColumn.line-break-permission = ##f b'8 c''8 fis''8 dis''8 e''2 \bar "|." }
>> }
\score { <<
  \new ChordNames \chordmode { f1:maj7 }
  \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \time 4/4 \override Score.NonMusicalPaperColumn.line-break-permission = ##f f'8 g'8 b'8 gis'8 a'2 \bar "|." }
